index_name: Business and Management Synthetic Frontier Research Index
aggregation: weighted geometric mean of benchmark scores, followed by an unweighted mean across the 12 tasks

BMA-COMP-01.rationale: Formal optimisation is closest to ORAgentBench, with reproducibility, paper-production and professional-execution support.

BMA-COMP-02.rationale: Simulation requires executable modelling and a stronger manuscript-production component.

BMA-COMP-03.rationale: Machine-learning research combines reproducible execution, experiment construction, result checking and business interpretation.

BMA-COMP-04.rationale: Forecasting combines reproducibility, experiment construction, executable modelling and professional interpretation.

BMA-SYN-01.rationale: Meta-analysis requires retrieval and synthesis plus reproducible quantitative checking.

BMA-SYN-02.rationale: Conceptual theory depends primarily on research depth, evidence integrity, sustained paper construction and business reasoning.

BMA-SYN-03.rationale: A systematic review requires report quality, citation integrity, evidence assessment and long-horizon synthesis.

BMA-SYN-04.rationale: A systematic review requires report quality, citation integrity, evidence assessment and long-horizon synthesis.

BMA-DATA-01.rationale: Corporate-panel research combines document interpretation, data reconstruction, statistical execution and evidence checking.

BMA-DATA-02.rationale: Spatial-panel research emphasises executable data analysis, modelling and reproducibility.

BMA-DATA-03.rationale: Input-output analysis is an executable operational and economic modelling workflow.

BMA-DATA-04.rationale: Corporate content analysis combines retrieval, source-grounded coding, reproducibility and business interpretation.

claim_rules: The index is a synthetic capability signal, not an observed BMA-ARB pass rate.
The frontier envelope combines different leading systems and harnesses and cannot be attributed to one model.
Benchmark metrics measure different constructs; index values are not calibrated probabilities.
The synthetic corpus-share proxy is illustrative and must not be reported as population prevalence or AI adoption.
